newsitem.title: USA: Stratosphere Corp misses bond payment.
newsitem.headline: Stratosphere Corp misses bond payment.

text.p: Stratosphere Corp, owner and operator of the Stratosphere hotel and casino in Las Vegas, said it failed to make a $14.5 million interest payment on its First Mortgage notes.
The payment had been due on November 15. A 30-day grace period has expired, constituting an "event of default," Stratosphere said in a statement issued late on Monday.

The company previously said it was highly unlikely that it would make this payment, and it might file bankruptcy as part of a debt restructuring. A bankruptcy filing would not, in the long run, adversely affect daily operations at the hotel.
Stratosphere said it continues to seek additional financing, but it noted the outcome of discussions with debt holders is uncertain.
